name: memory
description: Persistent key-value memory with semantic search (nomic-embed-text via Ollama). Store, retrieve, list, search, or delete notes that survive across sessions. USE IT OFTEN: proactively store any fact, name, email, preference, or detail you learn that you may need later - do not wait to be asked. STORE SPECIFIC KEYS, NOT BLOBS: one fact per key, with a specific descriptive key name (e.g. 'verna_email', 'verna_maker', 'verna_model'), never several unrelated facts crammed into one key - a blob only matches as a whole, so a specific detail buried in it will not be found by semantic search. QUERY IT WHEN UNSURE: if you are confused about something the user said, or a name, email, preference, or fact you may have stored before, search memory for it before asking the user to repeat it. Query it in the same manner. Falls back to substring search if Ollama is unavailable.

key.description: Memory key (used with store, get, delete).

query.description: Search term for semantic matching (used with action='search').
